policy.vrs_select_rule: When Valve's standings list the same organisation more than once (one row per counted roster), select the row whose roster lists a full five and whose latest published match date is the most recent; break ties on higher points. Alternatives are published on the Flagged for review page.
policy.bound_rule: An unlisted team has no verified rating. Absence from Valve's table does not prove it is weaker than the last listed team. Without an external quote or ratings for both teams, probabilities and picks remain blank and the fixture is published as unresolved.

limitations.title: Reference books do not price tier-C CS2
limitations.detail: 9 of 14 retained fixtures have no accepted price from Bovada, Melbet, Pinnacle, Thunderpick or Kalshi in the retained source captures. Those rows carry an originated line from Valve's official rating table only when both teams have a rating; otherwise they remain unresolved.

limitations.title: Originated lines are models, not market prices
limitations.detail: Formula p = 1/(1+exp(-k*C*points_delta)) with Valve's published C=0.0056000078 and this project's fitted k=0.43077894236569164 (60 market-vs-rating pairs). The fit's own mean absolute error is 7.70 percentage points, so this is in-sample market-fit error, not a confidence interval or demonstrated outcome accuracy.

limitations.title: Valve's rating table is 16 days old
limitations.detail: The newest published global table is 2026_10_05; Valve publishes roughly monthly. Promotion/relegation, roster changes and results after 5 Oct are not reflected. Valve rows also carry a latest_match_date per roster, which is published alongside every rating used here.

limitations.title: Missing rankings are not probability bounds
limitations.detail: No verified rating is available for at least one team in each unresolved fixture. No floor rating is imputed. A new external two-way price or verified ratings for both teams are needed before publishing a pick.

limitations.title: Thin exchange book on the one Kalshi-priced fixture
limitations.detail: The Kalshi quote used for Zetta v LOS NINOS has zero traded volume and a 0.16 wide two-way spread (Los Ninos 0.55/0.63, Alianza Lima 0.39/0.47). Our VRS origination and bo3.gg's own model both favour the other side, so the row is flagged as a basis conflict and the pick is shown with Lean confidence.

limitations.title: Clock conflicts are not silently joined
limitations.detail: Books occasionally list the same pairing at a different kick-off (e.g. Kalshi's Apogee Esports vs UNiTY esports event is priced at 16:30Z while HotSpawn and two other books have 14:00Z). Quotes are joined only when the kick-off agrees within 90 minutes; conflicts are listed on Flagged for review.

limitations.title: HotSpawn's own listing is not always complete
limitations.detail: Four DFRAG Invitational fixtures render a pick card with no match permalink, and one fixture (Wildcard v DENDELE, 12 Nov) exists in the fixtures API but is not rendered in the lobby and is marked 'started' months early. It is included here as an API-only row so no fixture is dropped.

irregularities.title: Unsupported unranked-team probability bounds removed
irregularities.detail: Earlier versions substituted Valve's lowest published rating for an unlisted opponent and claimed a directional bound. No official evidence establishes that ordering. Those fixtures now remain visible with blank picks and probabilities. Retained third-party reads have not been reverified live in this network-restricted session. Model estimates are not official odds, and in-sample calibration MAE is not a confidence interval.

irregularities.title: Valve publishes two rows for the same organisation (different rosters)
irregularities.detail: 1081597 benched gods v TitanFlow; 1081600 Donstu v Banda chuya; 1082792 HOTU v The Huns. Both rows are in standings_global_2026_10_05.md with different points. This build applies the published roster rule (full five, newest latest_match_date) and keeps the alternative in the row data, so the choice is auditable.

irregularities.title: Two collectors disagree on the same fixture and one leaves rows blank
irregularities.detail: data/fe803b80/board.json stores 13 open rows with the top-level pick/probability set to null while their own 'line' or 'model' block holds the numbers, and it also keeps a Kalshi quote whose sides are inverted (Turma do Pagode labelled at 0.78 when the exchange prices Imperial there). This build reads raw decimals and re-derives every no-vig price itself, and it does not import that inverted quote.

irregularities.title: Primary board resolves duplicate Valve rows the other way round
irregularities.detail: Both collectors mishandle Valve's duplicate rows, in opposite ways. data/f7279a54/board.json flags 'Banda chuya', 'The Huns' and 'benched gods' as ambiguous and therefore publishes no rating for those sides at all; data/fe803b80/board.json instead silently picks the older/lower rows (Banda Chuya #373 402 pts, The Huns #213 701 pts, benched gods #329 516 pts), which flips the Banda Chuya pick. bo3.gg's squad page for Banda Chuya lists exactly Valve's five-man row (#165, 801 pts, latest match 2026-10-04), and Valve's own latest_match_date column agrees, so the five-man row is the active one. Both the selected and the alternative values are published on every affected row.

irregularities.title: Kalshi market timestamps are shifted against its own rules text
irregularities.detail: Two independent events show the same offset: KXCS2GAME-26OCT211800LNALE's rules text says 'Oct 21, 2026 at 6:00 PM EDT' (22:00Z) while its occurrence_datetime says 2026-10-22T02:00:00Z, and KXCS2GAME-26OCT220100RAVA's rules text says 'Oct 22, 2026 at 1:00 AM EDT' (05:00Z) while its occurrence_datetime says 09:00Z - a +4h shift on both. The rules text agrees with HotSpawn, HLTV and bo3.gg, so the rules-text kick-off is used and the event clocks are treated as unreliable.

irregularities.title: The previous root landing page was not readable on a phone
irregularities.detail: The root index.html carried 12 header links and ~30 session cards before this session. This build adds one phone-first executive summary at the top of the root page that links straight to the picks, unresolved, sources, method and flagged pages, and keeps the older desks below it as an archive.
